soundness_flags.label: ass:fresh-iid-select
soundness_flags.one_line: The cited ICLR definition samples SELECT without replacement and only invokes a large-population approximation, so it does not support the stated exact independent fresh-unit condition as a standard named assumption.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: IDENTIFY+ returns an expression iff the factor is identifiable, and CTFIDU+ is sound and complete for an unnested query from supplied input distributions.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 2, Definition 2.1; p. 4, Assumption 3.1; p. 5, Theorem 3.5
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: SELECT is defined as random selection without replacement; the paper separately imposes one execution per causal mechanism and proves CTF-REALIZE complete. It does not state the proposal's exact independent fresh-unit SELECT condition.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 5, Theorem 1; p. 8, Lemma 3; p. 12, Lemma 7; p. 16, Proposition 3
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 1 gives the singleton reduction for a c-component target; Lemma 3 gives the minimum-weight hedge-hitting characterization; Lemma 7 and Proposition 3 certify the exact connected-target and general-target algorithms.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 1--2, abstract and problem formulation; p. 8, conclusion
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies minimum-cost permitted interventions for a specified ordinary causal effect, proves NP-hardness through vertex-cover/hitting-set reductions, and gives exact and logarithmic-approximation algorithms.

The paper proves an unnesting theorem, a necessary-and-sufficient graphical identification condition, and a complete nested-counterfactual identification algorithm from observational and experimental sources.
The paper establishes that positivity is needed for sound general identification and gives a sound-and-complete positivity-aware general-identification algorithm.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Retag ass:fresh-iid-select as a novel idealized sampling condition with a platform justification, or weaken it to the cited without-replacement SELECT condition and explicitly derive the cross-protocol product-law property needed by the optimizer.

Add a worked two-value, two-branch certificate instance showing a single protocol, slice, source, and transcript schema surviving distinct equality types; this makes the quantifier-exchange kernel independently auditable.
Strengthen the CTF-RAND separation to a parameterized nondegenerate family and prove a strict lower bound for every ordinary Q[S]-source design, not merely a one-instance cost comparison.

recommended_next_step: Correct the unsupported standard-tagged fresh-i.i.d SELECT assumption, then advance the field-tier uniform-certificate kernel to Stage 0.
